# FlareChoiceCard

`Flare.Components.FlareChoiceCard`

One option of a FlareChoiceGroup: a card with a title, a hint and a radio control, laid out by the group. It takes its name, its selected and its disabled state from the enclosing group, so the group stays the one place the answer lives.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Extra markup rendered under the title and hint, for an option whose body is more than two lines. Writing it between the tags binds here. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Disables this card individually. |
| `Hint` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Explanatory line under the title. |
| `Title` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Title of the option. |
| `Value` | `TValue?` | `` | Parameter |  | Value this card represents in the group. |
